note: Supplementary file - NOT a new line. 'Bellas Artes Maduro' already exists on the site with 4 vitolas (Gordo 6.5x58, Robusto 5.5x52, Short Churchill 6x48, Toro 6x54). Adding a 5th, limited-edition vitola the site is missing.

additional_vitolas.name: Lancero
additional_vitolas.notes: Limited-edition 5th size, added June 2019. Limited to 2,000 boxes of 10 (20,000 cigars total), ~$10/cigar MSRP. Made at Tabacalera A.J. Fernandez Cigars de Nicaragua, Estelí. Blend unchanged from the rest of the line: Brazilian Mata Fina wrapper, Mexican San Andrés binder, Nicaraguan filler.
